text:
[Council File 17-0090-S33]

HOMELESSNESS AND HEALTH COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Fourth Quarterly Report for Proposition HHH (Prop HHH) for Fiscal Year (FY) 2024-25, (April 1, 2025 – June 30, 2025) and the First and Second Quarterly Reports for Prop HHH for FY 2025-26, (July 1, 2025 – December 31, 2025).
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the Proposition HHH Administrative Oversight Committee report dated April 17, 2026, relative to the Fourth Quarterly Report for Prop HHH for Fiscal Year (FY) 2024-25, (April 1, 2025 – June 30, 2025) and the First and Second Quarterly Reports for Prop HHH for FY 2025-26, (July 1, 2025 – December 31, 2025), attached to the Council file.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable

None submitted
summary: Quarterly reports from the Prop HHH oversight committee covering April 2025 through December 2025, for council review.
